items.title: Bill Goodwin interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 28, 2025
items.q: And Bob and I had worked in L.A. together backing up a folk singer named Chad Mitchell.

ctx.x: More of a lifestyle decision. We had lived in California, I grew up there. I lived in my old neighborhood and we had a house. And we got to New York and we didn’t have a house and I was married and had a child, and we, you know we just did sublets or staying with

friends and all of that. But then we got to be, you know I was doing well on the gig and I knew we were going to hang for a while and came out to visit a friend that I had already made in Los Angeles, who I’m sure you knew about, Bob Dorough, the singer- songwriter.
